info.title: vendorval API
info.description: API-first entity lookup and verification. See /v1/docs for the interactive spec and /v1/openapi.json for the raw OpenAPI document. All routes except GET /v1/health require a bearer token.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Unauthenticated. Returns ok when the process is running. No DB or provider I/O.

get.summary: Liveness probe (uptime check alias)
get.description: Unauthenticated. Alias for /v1/health used by Cloud Monitoring uptime probes.

get.summary: Deep dependency health
get.description: Requires authentication. Reports live DB and provider status; returns 503 when degraded.

get.summary: Invitation-email pipeline diagnostic
get.description: Authenticated. Validates RESEND_API_KEY against Resend, confirms EMAIL_FROM domain is verified, and reports pgboss queue state. Never returns the secret value.

get.summary: List all countries VendorVal supports
get.description: Returns the full supported-country list with the identifiers and check types available in each country. Public — no API key required. Useful for populating country pickers and progressive-disclosure UIs.

get.summary: Country detail with provider attribution
get.description: Returns identifiers, checks, and the providers that contribute each check for one country. Returns 404 country_not_supported when the code is not in SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.

get.summary: Capabilities filtered by country (alias for /meta/countries/:code)
get.description: Convenience alias. Pass ?country=DE to get the same payload as GET /v1/meta/countries/DE. When country is omitted, returns the full list.

get.summary: Get the current Terms of Service
get.description: Returns the canonical Terms of Service. Default representation is JSON metadata + Markdown body; send `Accept: text/markdown` for the raw Markdown body so callers can pipe it directly to a renderer. Unauthenticated; cacheable for up to 5 minutes.

get.summary: Get the current Privacy Policy
get.description: Returns the canonical Privacy Policy. Default representation is JSON metadata + Markdown body; send `Accept: text/markdown` for the raw Markdown body so callers can pipe it directly to a renderer. Unauthenticated; cacheable for up to 5 minutes.

post.summary: Register a new organization for a Supabase-authenticated user
Accept an invitation to an organization

get.summary: Preview an invitation by its token (public)
get.description: Unauthenticated. Returns minimal invitation metadata so the dashboard sign-in page can render an "Accepting invitation" banner with the org name and prefill the invited email. Holders of the token already received the invitation email, so surfacing email + org name back to them leaks no new info. Discriminate on the returned `status` enum — `not_found` / `accepted` / `revoked` / `expired` are normal outcomes and are returned with HTTP 200, not 4xx.

post.summary: Record acceptance of Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for the current user
post.description: Stamps the current Terms of Service and Privacy Policy versions as accepted by the authenticated user. Idempotent: calling again with the current version is safe; calling again after a version bump records the new version. Returns 401 user_not_registered if the caller has no web_users row yet.

get.summary: Get the current authenticated user and org info
List the orgs the current user is a member of
get.description: Returns the full list of organizations the authenticated caller is a member of. Used by the dashboard org-switcher. Send `X-Org-Id` on subsequent requests to set the active org for the session. API-key callers receive a single-row list (the org their key is scoped to).

post.summary: Lookup an entity by any combination of identifiers
post.description: Read-only. Accepts a flat identifier object. Exact mode returns the strongest single match; fuzzy mode returns ranked candidates with confidence scores. Never creates entities. Set options.sam_refresh to control live SAM.gov fetching (auto | force | never). Country is resolved automatically from the strongest identifier (vat_id prefix, US-only ids imply US, …) or from the org default. `country` may be supplied explicitly to bypass inference, but it must agree with any country implied by an identifier — a conflict returns `country_mismatch` (422), it is not a silent override.

get.summary: Poll a queued hot-pull lookup job by correlation id
get.description: Companion to POST /v1/entities/lookup. Poll the `poll_url` returned with a `pending_async` lookup to learn whether the hot-pulled entity has since landed (`sync_pulled`, with the entity), is still being fetched (`pending_async`), or the pull reached a terminal negative (`not_found`). Scoped to the caller’s org; unknown or archived correlation ids return 404.

post.summary: Submit an entity candidate for authoritative check (internal/operator only)
post.description: Phase T1.4b/2b slice 1 — submissions are staged in `customer.entity_candidates` and processed asynchronously by the authoritative-check loop (SAM by UEI, GLEIF by LEI, VIES by VAT-ID, …). Returns 202 with a `candidate_id`; poll `GET /v1/entities/candidates/:id` for status. Customer-supplied data NEVER lands in canonical gold directly — only the authoritative-check loop can promote a candidate via the same reconciler path everything else uses. For customer entity lookups, use `POST /v1/entities/lookup` (which hot-pulls fresh authoritative data from SAM on cache miss). Requires the `internal:entities:write` scope (or wildcard `*`) on the API key.

get.summary: Search entities
Get an entity candidate by id
get.description: Phase T1.4b/2b slice 1 — polls the status of a candidate submitted via `POST /v1/entities`. Status values: `pending` (awaiting authoritative check), `matched` (promoted to canonical gold; `matched_entity_id` populated), `unmatched` (no authoritative source found a hit; awaiting operator review), `rejected` (operator declined). Requires `internal:entities:write` scope.

post.summary: Add an identifier to an existing entity (internal/operator only)
post.description: Phase T1.4b/2b — internal/operator-only as of 2026-05-24. Adding identifiers to a canonical entity is an authoritative-source operation (the identifier needs to be verified against a real source before being stamped on a canonical entity). Use `POST /v1/verify` to add identifiers via an authoritative check, or use the operator bulk-upload tooling. Requires the `internal:entities:write` scope.

get.summary: Company-name typeahead (member-accessible)
get.description: Returns up to N canonical entities ranked by legal-name similarity — the shared substrate for name search across the dashboard (certifications typeahead, monitors company-picker). Ranked by pg_trgm `similarity(normalized_name, q)` today; the wire contract (a `q` string → similarity-ranked companies each carrying a 0..1 `score`) is deliberately VECTOR-READY, so the resolver can later swap to embedding-KNN without any change to this endpoint or its consumers. Reads canonical gold (tenant-agnostic) and excludes suppressed dead-shell entities. `q` floors at 2 chars — company names can be short (e.g. "3M").

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text company-name query (typically what the user has typed so far).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return. Default 10, max 25.

get.summary: List entity snapshot history
Fetch an entity profile by its public ID
get.description: Full canonical record across all data sources for the entity — identifiers, addresses, exclusions, classifications, regulatory disclosures, certifications, registrations, and per-source frozen blocks (`sources.{name}`). One round-trip for the connected-fabric profile view. Use the source-blocks key to render per-authority detail panels.

post.summary: Verify + standardize a US address via USPS Addresses v3
post.description: Free to call. Always-fresh USPS call — no cache hit on this slice. For audited verification records (with a verification_id + monitor eligibility) attach the address to an entity and use POST /v1/verify with the `usps_address` check instead. Per-tenant rate limiting (matching the USPS upstream 60/min cap) lands in Phase S3.2 alongside the background sweep.

street_address.description: Street address line — number + street name (e.g. "1234 Main St"). USPS limits to 50 chars.

state.description: USPS 2-letter state code. Coerced to uppercase.

city.description: City. USPS needs one of (city, zip_code).

zip_code.description: ZIP-5. USPS needs one of (city, zip_code).

firm.description: Firm / business name at the address.

get.summary: Typeahead suggestions from the global address corpus
get.description: Returns up to N pg_trgm-ranked suggestions from `canonical_addresses` (a shared, tenant-agnostic corpus fed by silver USPS + bulk OpenAddresses). Free to call; the per-tenant rate-limit matches the synchronous /v1/addresses/lookup ceiling. Results are NOT verified addresses — use POST /v1/addresses/lookup to USPS-verify the user selection.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text address query (typically what the user has typed so far).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional USPS state code to constrain the search.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return. Default 10, max 25.

post.summary: Create a verification for an existing entity
post.description: Returns 200 with completed result when options.sync = true; otherwise returns 202 and runs the verification asynchronously.

get.summary: Fetch a verification by its public ID

post.summary: Resolve or create an entity, then run a verification
post.description: Convenience endpoint: looks up an entity by the supplied identifiers, runs the requested checks, and — when no entity matched — auto-creates the canonical entity if an identity-confirming authoritative check (tin_match / sam_registration / uei_validation / lei_validation) returns a definitive `pass`. If no such pass occurs the response carries the check results with `entity: null` and `entity_created: false` (nothing is written). `options.create_if_not_found` is no longer required; set it to force-create a customer-asserted entity without an authoritative pass (legacy/back-compat). **Synchronous by default** — the response carries fully-resolved per-check statuses. Pass `options: { sync: false }` to queue the verification asynchronously and poll `GET /v1/verifications/:id`. Accepts `identifiers` either as an object keyed by type (recommended, e.g. `{ "uei": "..." }`) or as a legacy array of `{ type, value }` pairs.

get.summary: List change events for a monitor
List certifications for the calling org
get.description: Lists Certification records for the calling org, optionally scoped by entity id, identifier, or a fuzzy company `name` search, and filtered by issuer, status, or expiring window. Pass `name` to find certs for the best-matching companies when you only have a company name (no id) — results are ordered best-matching-company-first. Phase O.A onwards, this surface is populated by state and national diversity-certifier adapters (NY-DMWBD, NMSDC, WBENC, etc.). Forward-compatible with non-diversity certs (ISO 9001, SOC 2, FedRAMP) — those carry an empty classifications array.

get.summary: List distinct certification issuers (catalog)
get.description: Returns the catalog of distinct `issuer` values present in `gold.certifications`. Use this to populate an issuer dropdown without hardcoding the authority list — when a new adapter lands (e.g. Phase O.D NY-OGS-SDVOB), this endpoint immediately reflects it without a dashboard release. Sorted alphabetically. Tenant-agnostic because gold is canonical reference data (post-Phase-T4). For "issuers I personally have certs for", filter `/v1/certifications?entity_id=...` instead.

get.summary: Fetch a single certification by ID

post.description: Creates a new organization. JWT-authenticated callers (dashboard users) are added as the org owner with a default API key — the existing default org (web_users.org_id) is left unchanged, so accepting this response then switching org context is the dashboard's job via the X-Org-Id header.

Get per-day usage for the current billing period
List audit-log events for an organization
get.description: Returns a tenant-scoped, time-ordered (most-recent first) list of audit events. JWT-only. Supports cursor pagination via `before` (pass the last row's `created_at`) plus optional filters: `action`, `subject_type`/`subject_id`, `severity`, `outcome`, and a bounded date range (`since` / `until`).

get.summary: Count audit-log events matching filters
List configured providers and their capabilities

post.summary: Create a Stripe checkout session to subscribe to a plan
Create a Stripe billing portal session to manage subscription

get.summary: Get the current subscription for the authenticated org
get.description: Returns the org subscription plus an explicit `is_manually_billed` boolean. An org with a subscription but NO Stripe customer is billed manually (invoice / account-team contract) rather than through self-serve Stripe checkout. Clients MUST branch billing UI on this flag, never on a mutable plan label (e.g. `plan === "enterprise"`), which breaks on custom plan names.

get.summary: Whether the authenticated org is a paying subscriber (docs gate)
get.description: Member-accessible entitlement check for the docs.vendorval.com softwall. `subscribed` is true when the org has a subscription in an active / trialing / past_due state. No free plan exists, so any such subscription is a paid one. Unlike /v1/billing/subscription (owner/admin only), any org member may call this.
